audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Illustrative procedural scene: flat SVG line drawing; no physical paper, ink bleed or blueprint-print texture is simulated.
Composition is 1280x720 (viewBox 1280x720 drafting units, 1 unit = 1 mm at 1:1 scale); it scales to 1920x1080 through the SVG viewBox.
The 45-degree hatch pattern has a 7-unit pitch (about 10.5 px at 1080p) to avoid aliasing; it has not been checked in a rendered frame here.
Preview shows one part view with 4 dimensions (Ø180, 54, 70, 120). The full multi-view video that chains views through labels is not built.
White #FFFFFF on #1B3ED2 contrast is 7.88, computed with chroma.contrast; grid lines are drawn at 0.25/0.5 stroke-opacity for decoration only.
Typography uses system Courier New/Menlo monospace; no web fonts are bundled.
